units.source_text: 鞋子里灌满了沙，脚趾头疼起来。

en.t: His shoes were filled with sand, and his toes began to hurt.

units.source_text: 回过头来一看，追兵拉在右后方七八十米远的地方。

en.t: When he looked back, his pursuers were trailing seventy or eighty meters behind to his right.

units.source_text: 怎么回事，走错路线了吗？

en.t: What was going on? Had they taken the wrong route?

units.source_text: 恐怕是太想避开斜坡，反而干出那样的蠢事来。

en.t: They had probably been so intent on avoiding the slope that they had ended up doing something foolish instead.
They seemed to be extremely tired as well...
As the saying goes, pursuers tire easily...

units.source_text: 他赶快脱了鞋，光着脚丫……

en.t: He quickly took off his shoes and went barefoot...

units.source_text: 口袋鼓胀，会变得累赘，他把口袋掖进裤腰里。

en.t: His bulging pockets would become a burden, so he tucked them into the waistband of his trousers.

units.source_text: 定了定神，一口气跑上陡坡。

en.t: After steadying himself, he ran up the steep slope in one burst.

units.source_text: 按这气势，弄得好，不一定会输给那些家伙……

en.t: At this pace, if he handled it well, he might not necessarily lose to those men...
